outcome: Existing game-end behavior works; no product changes required.
limitations: Damage and death were triggered on StateAuthority through the existing ApplyDamage, Kill and consumeSprintHealth methods.
No mission-completion or timeout handler was invoked by the test. Players sent no movement/mission input.
The sprint-health case called the existing health-consumption method; physical sprint-key and weapon-hit input were not simulated.
Result text, overlay alpha and input restoration were checked at runtime; no manual pixel or audio listening test.
Existing Laver_Shader_Graph shader parse error persists; test Windows build succeeded.
Isolated Lobby-start test omitted the Main global friend-invite transport; friend invites were not tested.
